description: A number with an exponent after a dot is accepted as a legacy index
notes: The spec's grammar allows only digits after the dot (LegacyIndex = '.' digit+), so 1e0 is not a legacy index. hashicorp/hcl accepts any number token after a dot that contains no period, including one with an exponent, and uses its value as the key (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go).
